tests.code: let a = SelfRef::new("x"); let before = a.pointer; let moved = a; assert_eq!(before, &moved.value as *const String); assert_eq!(moved.as_ref().read(), "x");
let mut a = SelfRef::new("x"); let mut b = SelfRef::new("y"); std::mem::swap(&mut a, &mut b); assert_eq!(a.value, a.as_ref().read()); assert_eq!(a.as_ref().read(), "y");
